# fshy: Debrid in full

> A debrid service downloads files from many file hosts through one account, at full speed. Also premium-link generators, usenet and retrieval services.

Data as of 2026-11-26, the date of the published data. Version `12288cc5e8c1`: the first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of every record's Markdown, topic by topic in the one order (hosted before self-hosted, then verdict, provider name, record id); it changes whenever a record does.

This topic is 2,718 KB, about 735K tokens in full, more than the 300 KB, about 81K tokens one file holds, so it is split: its hosted records by verdict group, then its self-hosted records in one last group, and a group over that size into balanced parts. The parts in the order below are the one order (hosted before self-hosted, then verdict, provider name, record id). How to read a record: https://fshy.ajam.dev/llms-full.txt.
